description: Check a single piece of untrusted text (a user message, a retrieved RAG document, tool output, etc.) for prompt injection, jailbreaks, instruction-override, data-exfiltration, and code injection BEFORE passing it to an LLM. Returns a safe/unsafe verdict with confidence, threat category, and reasoning. Call this on any untrusted input you are about to feed to a model.

sensitivity.description: Optional. Omit to use the account default. 'no_judgement' blocks only clear attacks, for apps whose users tell the AI exactly what to write. 'balanced' is an older name for it. 'strict' and 'lenient' are accepted for existing callers.

name: validate_prompt
title: Validate a prompt for injection attacks
